data: BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: How do I treat an ingrown toenail? ASSISTANT:

Ingrown toenails can often be treated at home with regular foot care. It may also be necessary to soften the skin with an over-the-counter medication. If the ingrown toenail becomes recurrent or is severe, it may need to be professionally removed.
